title: GTA 6 Map Poster Leak Shows Lummox County, Pelican Valley
description: The GTA 6 map poster from the $400 Collector's Edition leaked online, showing Lummox County, Pelican Valley and Moreau in Leonida, per Moneycontrol.

body.text: The GTA 6 map poster has leaked, and with it most of the fictional state of Leonida. According to Moneycontrol, citing a Notebookcheck report, an Instagram account posted an unboxing of the Goodtime State – Vice City Collection, the game's Collector's Edition, which includes a printed poster of Leonida. For fans who have been piecing the world together from trailers, it is the widest look at the layout so far.
What the GTA 6 map poster shows

The poster displays most regions and their labels, though some edges, including the Leonida Keys, are not fully visible. Moneycontrol notes that several regions had not been shown officially until now.
Newly seen areas include Lummox County in the north and a location called Moreau. Further south, the map shows Pelican Valley, which sits inside the Grassrivers region.

items: Toll roads are marked on the print, which matches a detail from the game's Netflix Extended Look trailer.
A blimp icon appears on the map.
Goose Key showed up in the southern section of an earlier, folded version of the map.

body.text: That earlier glimpse came when a Collector's Box was put on display at a Selfridges store in Manchester, according to the report.

The unboxing reel has since been deleted from Instagram. Before that happened, it was reshared on X by a user named Tex2, which is how the images spread. Nothing here comes from Rockstar itself, so treat the details as what the poster shows rather than a full official map.
GTA 6 map buy: who gets the physical copy

The physical map comes only with the Vice City Collection, priced at $400 on pre-order. Moneycontrol's report gives the price in dollars only. Standard physical copies for PS5 and Xbox do not include a map, which breaks from earlier Rockstar releases such as GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2. Those retail boxes instead contain a double-sided poster featuring the cover art.
If you do not want the collector's package, there is a fallback. Rockstar Games will offer a downloadable digital version of the map on or shortly after the release date, the report said.

The leak follows reported action against the GTA 6 Mapping Project, a community effort that built a chart of Vice City and Leonida from trailers and screenshots. Its Discord server reportedly received a DMCA strike, which may have come from Take-Two Interactive or Rockstar Games. The source of the strike is not confirmed. The project's website remains online.

Members of the mapping project are expected to go through the Instagram footage for more detail, so expect fan-made maps to get more complete soon. Keep an eye out for any official word from Rockstar on the digital map and on how the Vice City Collection ships. Until then, the poster is a strong hint at Leonida's layout, not a final guide.

faqs.q: What does the leaked GTA 6 map poster show?
faqs.a: According to Moneycontrol, it shows most regions of Leonida with labels, including newly seen areas such as Lummox County, Moreau and Pelican Valley. Some edges, including the Leonida Keys, are not fully visible.

faqs.q: Which GTA 6 edition comes with the map poster?
faqs.a: The printed map is included only with the Goodtime State – Vice City Collection, which costs $400 on pre-order. Standard physical copies for PS5 and Xbox do not include it, per the report.

faqs.q: Will there be a digital version of the GTA 6 map?
faqs.a: Moneycontrol, citing Notebookcheck, says Rockstar Games will offer a downloadable digital version of the map on or shortly after the release date.
